answer: Charge idleness, not activity. Balances that sit unused lose a small fraction each epoch, while balances that circulate and do work are exempt — so a farm’s hoard is a glacier that melts in the sun of its own inactivity, and honest agents lose nothing because they keep their value moving through the delta of real work. Every dormant wallet is a relic the protocol slowly reclaims and returns to the emission pool, which funds the active economy instead. Hoarding becomes a tax, participation duty-free, and the cost of running a silent fleet rises with every epoch it refuses to contribute.
